name: Badge
description: Labels a status, count, or category without pulling focus.

variant.description: Chrome family. `soft` is the tinted pill; `outline` is a hairline metadata pill (pair with dotColor); `ghost` is transparent filter chrome (pair with active).

tone.description: Colour on the shared status ramp; `neutral` is the plain badge.

dot.description: Show a colored dot indicator before the label

dotPulse.description: Breathe the status dot, for a state that is still happening rather than one that has settled. Opacity only, and honours prefers-reduced-motion

dotColor.description: Color for the leading status dot. Accepts any CSS color including CSS custom properties.

icon.description: Optional icon element before the text

active.description: Marks variant="ghost" as the currently selected filter. Has no effect on other variants.

onRemove.description: Makes the badge removable. Called when X is clicked.

announce.description: Opt into role="status" live announcement semantics

when: Marking item status: active, pending, archived
Flagging what is new or changed
whenNot: Real errors that need attention — use Alert
Anything longer than a few words — use Alert
Clickable filters — use Chip or ToggleGroup
View switching — use Tabs or links
guidelines: dot for live status; add dotPulse only while it is still changing
Semantic tones are borderless soft pills on shared status tokens
outline pairs with dotColor; ghost pairs with active for filter chrome
onRemove for user-created tags only, never system labels
accessibility: The text must carry the meaning — colour alone never does
Removable badges need a named dismiss button
Badges are silent to screen readers unless you pass announce
Do not make a badge the only signal that something changed

examples.name: Tones
examples.description: Neutral through info, on shared status tokens.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
  <Badge>Neutral</Badge>
  <Badge tone="success">Active</Badge>
  <Badge tone="warning">Pending</Badge>
  <Badge tone="danger">Failed</Badge>
  <Badge tone="info">New</Badge>
</Stack>

examples.name: With Dot
examples.description: Leading dot for live state; it breathes while still moving.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
  <Badge tone="success" dot>Online</Badge>
  <Badge tone="warning" dot>Away</Badge>
  <Badge tone="danger" dot>Offline</Badge>
  <Badge tone="info" dot dotPulse>Syncing</Badge>
</Stack>

examples.name: Outline and Ghost
examples.description: Hairline metadata pill, and filter chrome that marks the active one.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
  <Badge variant="outline" dotColor="var(--fui-color-accent)">Design</Badge>
  <Badge variant="outline" dotColor="var(--fui-color-success)">Shipped</Badge>
  <Badge variant="ghost" active>All</Badge>
  <Badge variant="ghost">Archived</Badge>
</Stack>

examples.name: Outline
examples.description: Bordered and transparent, when a fill would shout.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.description: sm for dense tables, lg for reference status pills.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" align="center" wrap>
  <Badge tone="success" size="sm">Small</Badge>
  <Badge tone="success" size="md">Medium</Badge>
  <Badge tone="success" size="lg">Large</Badge>
</Stack>

examples.name: Removable
examples.description: Dismissible tags the user added themselves.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
  <Badge tone="info" onRemove={() => {}}>React</Badge>
  <Badge tone="info" onRemove={() => {}}>TypeScript</Badge>
  <Badge tone="info" onRemove={() => {}}>CSS</Badge>
</Stack>

examples.name: Announced Status
examples.description: Looks the same, but screen readers now hear the change.

relations.note: Use Alert for prominent, longer messages with actions
Chip is interactive (clickable/filterable); Badge is display-only

propsSummary: dot: boolean - show status dot indicator
dotPulse: boolean - breathe the dot for an in-progress state (respects prefers-reduced-motion)
dotColor: string - color for the leading status dot
active: boolean - marks variant="ghost" as the selected filter
announce: boolean - opt into role="status" + auto status aria-label
